annotation.cut_point:
We are given that Bob has **30 identical unit cubes**, and he can **glue two cubes together face-to-face**. He must glue all 30 cubes **together into one connected solid**. We are to find the **largest possible surface area** of such a solid.

---

### Step 1: Understanding the process

- Each cube has **6 faces**.
- When two cubes are glued face-to-face, **one face is glued**, and the other face is **left exposed**.

verified_state: Bob has 30 identical unit cubes and must glue them all into one connected solid by joining faces.
reflection.error_step: - When two cubes are glued face-to-face, **one face is glued**, and the other face is **left exposed**.
reflection.error_reason: When two cubes are glued face-to-face, two faces (one from each cube) are joined and hidden, so no face from that glued pair is left exposed.
reflection.new_direction: State that each glued contact hides exactly two faces and therefore reduces total surface area by 2.
